title: Surreal Chess Apocalypse
description: Three women in black dresses sit on ornate chairs atop a cracked chessboard. The left two have large melting eyes for heads with dripping liquid, the right one has a normal pale face with closed eyes. Fiery yellow meteors streak across a dark sky filled with a crowd of identical floating screaming faces with glowing eyes. The board is populated with golden chess pieces while colorful flowers grow in the background near gravestones.
prompt: Surreal dark scene with three women seated on chairs on a cracked black and yellow chessboard. Two women have giant melting eyeballs for heads with yellow liquid dripping down, the third has a normal pale face with closed eyes and black hair. Golden chess pieces are scattered on the board with fiery yellow meteors streaking past them. Background shows a crowd of identical floating ghostly faces with glowing orange eyes in a black sky, colorful flowers and gravestones behind the figures, dramatic symbolic composition in a dark surreal style.
